consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: availability and testing of fixed fire protection

facts.title: corrective action - material unwanted event control at PSV-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIXED_FIRE_SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY: the availability and testing of fixed fire protection was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the availability and testing of fixed fire protection on PSV-8201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in mustering and rescuing, specifically deploying an emergency response team. PSV-8201 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the availability and testing of fixed fire protection was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 4 April 2026 a corrective action on PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
